author: Piersen Maass
title: Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway celebrates the planting of the 100,000th tree in Madison
text: MADISON (WKOW) -- The city of Madison, including Madison Mayor Satya Rhodes-Conway, held an event to mark an ongoing goal in their Urban Canopy project.
